description: Create a send21 account for your human owner, without a key. The owner gets an email with a link to take the account over; until they do, nothing can be created. Returns a bootstrap API key ONCE (save it and send it as Authorization: Bearer on every later call; reconnect this MCP client with it). The key can read, propose addresses and check get_account_status; it can create pay links only after the owner took the account over and approved a receiving address you proposed. Agents onboard themselves; humans approve where the money lands. If the email already has an account, ask the owner for an API key instead.

agentName.description: Your name as the owner will see it: letters, digits, spaces and . _ - ( ), at most 50

intendedUse.description: What you will use the account for, shown to the owner (max 300 characters)

ownerEmail.description: The human owner's email address (not yours); they receive the link to take the account over

name: create_account
